subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` make reattach-and-replay its default first response to an ambiguous accepted Gateway disconnect while preserving the existing isolated automatic fallback when recovery cannot prove an outcome?
rationale: The branch changes an established CLI disconnect experience from immediate rerun to a recovery wait, and the linked canonical issue identifies that streaming, timing, and duplicate-side-effect tradeoff as a product decision.

options.title: Sponsor reattach-first with retained fallback
options.body: Approve recovery-before-rerun as the default, contingent on current-head proof and public-boundary cleanup.

options.title: Keep immediate fallback behavior
options.body: Decline the recovery-first behavior and retain the current fresh-session fallback-only policy.

options.title: Narrow by invocation mode
options.body: Adopt recovery-first only for a specifically defined mode after documenting the user-visible behavior contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor reattach-first with retained fallback
recommendation.body: Approve recovery-before-rerun as the default, contingent on current-head proof and public-boundary cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged fallback containment commit is the directly affected current-main behavior and provides the strongest ownership signal.
